risk: Trading in derivatives, including rolling spot Foreign Exchange (FX) and Contracts for Difference (CFDs), is highly speculative, carries a substantial degree of risk, and is not appropriate for every investor. Nothing on this website constitutes investment advice or a recommendation, and it has been prepared without regard to your individual objectives, financial circumstances or needs.

FX and CFDs are complex instruments dealt on a margined basis and carry a high risk of losing money rapidly by reason of leverage, which magnifies gains and losses alike. You may lose part or all of your invested capital, and losses may exceed your initial investment. Before trading, you should consider your objectives, financial position, level of experience and appetite for risk, satisfy yourself that you understand how these products operate, and trade only with funds you can afford to lose. Seek independent financial or tax advice if in any doubt. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

The entity with which a client contracts will depend on the client's jurisdiction, eligibility, classification and onboarding route. The applicable contracting entity and, where relevant, the product issuer and/or counterparty will be clearly disclosed before the client submits an account application and will be identified in the relevant Client Agreement. Products and services available under one entity may not be available under another entity. Each entity within the GTC Financial Group is a separate legal entity. A licence held by one entity does not extend to any other entity within the group.

faq.subtitle: Here’s what visitors ask us most. Still unsure? Our team at the booth is happy to help.

items.q: Do I need to deposit to get the ${amount} bonus?
items.a: No. Open a GTC Standard account through this page and the ${amount} USD trading bonus is added once your account is activated. No deposit is needed.

items.q: Why don’t I choose a password?
items.a: To keep sign-up quick, we create a secure password for you and email it with your login details as soon as your account is open. Change it after your first login.

items.q: How do I activate my account?
items.a: Log in to the client portal with the details we emailed you, complete your profile and verify your identity. The bonus is unlocked once verification is approved.

items.q: What can I trade with the bonus?
items.a: Use it to trade real markets: forex, metals, energy, indices and more, on MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5 or the GTC Go app.
The bonus itself is for trading. Profits you make with it can be withdrawn according to the bonus terms. Please read the Bonus Terms before you start.

items.q: I didn’t get the email. What now?
items.a: Check your spam or junk folder first. If it still hasn’t arrived, ask our team at the booth or email support and we’ll resend your details.
